name: Master Vornal
summary: In Sen'jin Village, Master Vornal brews for the Darkspear trolls and keeps his craft to himself. The elderly jungle troll refuses to take on apprentices despite his deep knowledge of alchemy.

sections.title: The Stubborn Brewer of Sen'jin
sections.body: Master Vornal brews draughts and spirits for his fellow Darkspear trolls in Sen'jin Village. Age is catching up with him, but he remains fiercely independent and refuses to train an apprentice. He mixes his remedies and volatile brews by his own hand.

sections.title: A Solvent Spirit
sections.body: Master Vornal sometimes sends young adventurers to gather harsh or unusual ingredients from the surrounding lands. The materials go into solvents and other mixtures. He rewards those who help, but guards his methods and recipes, keeping the work of brewing to himself.

faq.answer: Master Vornal is an elderly Darkspear jungle troll who brews spirits and remedies in Sen'jin Village. He insists on working without an apprentice.

faq.q: Where can I find Master Vornal?
faq.answer: Master Vornal stands among the huts in Sen'jin Village, on Durotar's southern coast just north of the Echo Isles.

faq.q: Why does Master Vornal refuse to take apprentices?
faq.answer: Master Vornal says no troll or orc worthy of teaching has come forward. His eyesight is failing, and he relies more on alchemy, but he would rather work alone than teach someone unworthy.

faq.q: What tasks does he offer adventurers?
faq.answer: Master Vornal sends wanderers across the region to gather raw components for his solvent mixtures. He relies on travelers for materials and keeps the brewing to himself.

angles.text: As a Darkspear troll, you can see Master Vornal as one of the stubborn elder craftspeople who helped establish Sen'jin Village after the tribe fled its island home.
With Herbalism, you can recognize Master Vornal's search for rare catalysts and harsh natural reagents for his solvents.
